nodes.description: Public view function allBalances(address[] _tokens, address _who) that loops over arbitrary token addresses and reads balances and deposit locks from each wrapper contract.
Parameter _tokens: caller-supplied array of token/wrapper contract addresses used as external call targets.
Parameter _who: caller-supplied account whose balances and locks are queried.
Loop counter i iterating over the _tokens array.
Local array balances returning balanceOf results for each token.
Local array locks returning depositLock results for each token.
External call WrapperInterface(_tokens[i]).balanceOf(_who) to an unvalidated, caller-controlled contract address inside a loop.
External call WrapperInterface(_tokens[i]).depositLock(_who) to an unvalidated, caller-controlled contract address inside a loop.

edges.reason: The _tokens parameter is supplied by the caller and drives the execution of allBalances.
The _who parameter is supplied by the caller and drives the execution of allBalances.
The allBalances function body invokes the external balanceOf call on each loop iteration.
The allBalances function body invokes the external depositLock call on each loop iteration.
Each element of _tokens is cast to WrapperInterface and used as the unvalidated target of balanceOf.
_who is passed directly as the argument to the external balanceOf call.
Each element of _tokens is cast to WrapperInterface and used as the unvalidated target of depositLock.
_who is passed directly as the argument to the external depositLock call.
The loop counter i selects which token address is used for the balanceOf call.
The loop counter i selects which token address is used for the depositLock call.
The return value of balanceOf is stored into the balances array element.
The return value of depositLock is stored into the locks array element.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _tokens only exists to drive allBalances and the external wrapper calls it performs, so it can be folded into the function node.
Parameter _who is only forwarded to the external calls made by allBalances and can be folded into the function node.
Local loop counter i is internal iteration bookkeeping of allBalances and can be merged into the function node.
Local array balances is filled exclusively by the return value of the external balanceOf call, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
Local array locks is filled exclusively by the return value of the external depositLock call, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
